_README: The shared connection-type vocabulary — the stud sizes. Two organ ports connect iff their `type` matches. Curated deliberately: a new type is added only when no existing one fits (sprawl defeats the standard). Each type pins the shape that flows on that wire. See CONNECTORS.md.
_VENDORED: This is a PINNED COPY of Data-Flow-Advisory/orchestrator@feat/drift-gate:types.json so this organ's conformance check can validate ports.json offline (stdlib-only CI, no network). The `types` block reproduces the seed vocabulary verbatim. The names in `_proposed` are NEW types this organ needs that the seed vocabulary did not cover (spec-task pipeline); they are added to `types` here so conformance is green, AND proposed for review/upstreaming into the orchestrator vocabulary in this PR. Keep this copy in sync when the upstream vocabulary changes.

TenantContext.desc: A resolved tenant: identity, branding, provenance bag.

SiteCrawl.desc: Signals crawled from a prospect's website at signup.

InterviewTranscript.desc: Ordered Q&A pairs from a discovery interview.

KeyFacts.desc: Themed facts extracted from a transcript (the discovery memory).

EntityGraph.desc: Deduplicated canonical entities (people, systems, tools) per tenant.

Blueprint.desc: The system blueprint: modules + integrations + current/recommended state.

ProcessFlow.desc: Sequence / swimlane of a workflow extracted from transcript themes.

AccountState.desc: A fleet account's pacing/quota state (the pace + drift gates' input).

ClaimVerdict.desc: Whether a worker may claim work now, and why (gate output).

BillingState.desc: A tenant's subscription / billing state + feature entitlements.

ConformanceVerdict.desc: Whether an organ/output conforms + groundedness (self_metric shape).

ApparatusSource.desc: A pointer to something the fresh apparatus should scan for useful specs/features — the OLD apparatus or any source.

RawArtefacts.desc: Raw scanned content from a source, before it is decomposed into discrete features.

CandidateFeatures.desc: Discrete specs/features decomposed out of the raw scan — the candidates to judge.

JudgedFeatures.desc: Candidates after judgment — the useful ranked, the useless rejected (reject is first-class).

ProvenancedArtefact.desc: Any spec/feature the scan-and-select takes from the OLD apparatus, wrapped with its origin + succession status so the new machine knows it as inherited, never native. Retain history, know it as such — succession baked in, the antidote to old-artefacts-polluting-new. See FRESH_APPARATUS.md.

SpecTaskGraph._status: PROPOSED — not yet in the orchestrator seed vocabulary; minted by organ-spec-tasks (this PR) because no seed type covers a spec's task graph. Review before merge.
SpecTaskGraph.desc: A technical spec's ordered task definitions with dependency edges — the work graph a spec-writer emits and the spec-task sequencer consumes. The wire value is the task list (the organ reads it under state['tasks']).

TaskStateMap._status: PROPOSED — not yet in the orchestrator seed vocabulary; minted by organ-spec-tasks (this PR). Review before merge.
TaskStateMap.desc: Per-task lifecycle status for a spec's tasks, keyed by task id. A task with no slot defaults to 'pending'. Statuses: pending | in_progress | completed | completed_pending_review | failed.

ApprovalGate._status: PROPOSED — not yet in the orchestrator seed vocabulary; minted by organ-spec-tasks (this PR). Review before merge.
ApprovalGate.desc: A boolean operator-approval flag that gates whether downstream work may begin. The wire value is the bare flag (the organ reads it under state['approved']); false hard-blocks claiming.

SpecTaskDecision._status: PROPOSED — not yet in the orchestrator seed vocabulary; minted by organ-spec-tasks (this PR). Review before merge.
SpecTaskDecision.desc: The single next action a worker should take against a spec's task graph, plus progress. decision is one of: not_approved | no_tasks | claim | spec_complete | in_progress | blocked. next_task is the serialised task to claim (only on 'claim'), else null.
